question: For each pizza order, provide a single result row with the row ID, order ID, customer ID, pizza name, and final set of ingredients. The final ingredients are determined by starting with the standard toppings from the pizza’s recipe, removing any excluded toppings, and adding any extra toppings. Present the ingredients in a string starting with the pizza name followed by ': ', with ingredients listed in alphabetical order. Ingredients appearing multiple times (e.g., from standard and extra toppings) should be prefixed with '2x' and listed first, followed by single-occurrence ingredients, both in alphabetical order. Group by row ID, order ID, pizza name, and order time to ensure each order appears once. Sort results by row ID in ascending order. Assign pizza_id 1 to 'Meatlovers' pizzas and pizza_id 2 to all others.

WITH excluded_parts AS (
    SELECT 
        rowid AS row_id,
        order_id,
        TRIM(UNNEST(string_split(exclusions, ','))) AS exc_id
    FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders
    WHERE exclusions IS NOT NULL
),
excluded_topping_ids AS (
    SELECT 
        row_id,
        order_id,
        CAST(exc_id AS INTEGER) AS exc_id
    FROM excluded_parts
),
extra_parts AS (
    SELECT 
        rowid AS row_id,
        order_id,
        TRIM(UNNEST(string_split(extras, ','))) AS extra_id
    FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders
    WHERE extras IS NOT NULL
),
extra_topping_ids AS (
    SELECT 
        row_id,
        order_id,
        CAST(extra_id AS INTEGER) AS extra_id
    FROM extra_parts
),
standard_toppings AS (
    SELECT 
        rco.rowid AS row_id,
        rco.order_id,
        rco.customer_id,
        rco.pizza_id,
        pn.pizza_name,
        rco.order_time,
        CAST(st.top_id AS INTEGER) AS topping_id,
        t.topping_name
    FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders rco
    JOIN pizza_names pn ON pn.pizza_id = rco.pizza_id
    JOIN pizza_recipes pr ON pr.pizza_id = rco.pizza_id
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(string_split(pr.toppings, ', ')) AS st(top_id)
    JOIN pizza_toppings t ON t.topping_id = CAST(st.top_id AS INTEGER)
),
all_toppings AS (
    SELECT 
        st.row_id,
        st.order_id,
        st.customer_id,
        st.pizza_name,
        st.order_time,
        st.topping_name
    FROM standard_toppings st
    LEFT JOIN excluded_topping_ids et ON et.row_id = st.row_id AND et.exc_id = st.topping_id
    WHERE et.exc_id IS NULL
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        et.row_id,
        et.order_id,
        rco.customer_id,
        pn.pizza_name,
        rco.order_time,
        t.topping_name
    FROM extra_topping_ids et
    JOIN pizza_clean_customer_orders rco ON rco.rowid = et.row_id
    JOIN pizza_names pn ON pn.pizza_id = rco.pizza_id
    JOIN pizza_toppings t ON t.topping_id = et.extra_id
),
topping_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_name, order_time,
        topping_name,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM all_toppings
    GROUP BY row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_name, order_time, topping_name
),
formatted AS (
    SELECT 
        row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_name, order_time,
        topping_name,
        cnt,
        CASE WHEN cnt > 1 THEN '2x' || topping_name ELSE topping_name END AS display_name
    FROM topping_counts
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY row_id 
            ORDER BY CASE WHEN cnt > 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, topping_name
        ) AS rn
    FROM formatted
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT 
        row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_name, order_time,
        string_agg(display_name, ', ' ORDER BY rn) AS ingredients
    FROM ranked
    GROUP BY row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_name, order_time
)
SELECT 
    row_id,
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    pizza_name,
    CASE WHEN pizza_name = 'Meatlovers' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS pizza_id,
    pizza_name || ': ' || ingredients AS ingredients
FROM aggregated
ORDER BY row_id
